headline.note: L1.75 FULL added signal importance but did not improve global all-ticket probability quality. Market odds remain the strongest global baseline.

interpretation: Do not discard L1.75; prior horse-level divergence evidence shows useful conditional signal.
Do not ask a flexible ticket model to relearn the entire market probability surface from scratch.
Next architecture should treat normalized market quinella probability as the baseline and learn only an L1.75 residual/logit correction.
No TopN filtering, hard STRONG tag, or handcrafted buying rule should be introduced yet.
next: L2_TICKET_RESIDUAL_V1: cross-fitted additive/logit correction to MARKET_RAW using King, Outsider, and L1.75 disagreement features; evaluate global calibration plus disagreement subsets.
